svg.text: From clicking a project to using the IDE
/projects/[projectId] · route files, the IDE frame, and what happens when you drag, switch tabs or rename
You are on the landing page (/)
ProjectsList: <Link href="/projects/<id>"> (the card or a recent project)
or Ctrl K → pick one → router.push("/projects/<id>")
→ client-side navigation: no full page reload
[projectId] = dynamic route → both await params → projectId
project is not null → render the frame:
sidebar: minSize 200, maxSize 800, snap → draws the drag handle
owner check → returns the project, or null
a project → <Navbar project={project} />: name + "Saved 2 minutes ago"
allotment resizes the panes itself: no React state in our code
drag the chat sidebar below 200 px → snaps closed; drag back → reopens
Code layer → invisible, Preview layer → visible
Enter or click away → handleSubmit → renameProject({ id, name })
verifyAuth → owner check → ctx.db.patch(id, { name, updatedAt })
projects table changed → getById re-runs → Navbar shows the new name
(get / getPartial re-run too → landing list order updates)
→ their subscriptions end → the landing page renders again
